title: Expedition slots and recall
kicker: Idle expeditions · parallelism and early return
hook: **Slots** let you run more than one expedition at once; **recall** brings a squad home early for what you have earned so far.

blindSpots.meaning: A parallel expedition berth. You start with a few and grow into more as the system allows — not infinite dispatches.
Pull an expedition home before the timer ends. Rewards pro-rate to completed ticks.
You take what completed so far — not a full payout and not a wipe of the run.
A demon already out on an expedition (or another live assignment) cannot be double-booked.

alsoTrue: Recall anytime is intentional — leave early, take earned so far. Nothing expires if you forget to collect.
How many slots you have grows with progression; trust the UI for the current count.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Parallelism is gated by expedition slots — you grow from a few to more as you progress.
Recall is the escape hatch when you need those demons back before the timer ends.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Two controls around the same dispatch loop:

cards.name: Slots
cards.body: Each free slot can hold one expedition. Fill what you have; unlock more when the system allows.

cards.name: Recall
cards.body: End early. Rewards scale to completed ticks — you keep progress earned so far, not the full end payout.

groups.title: On the Expeditions layer
groups.intro: Open Expeditions (`E`) after you have a bound demon.
steps: Look at how many slots are free versus filled.
If you need the squad back early, use recall and read the pro-rated report.
groups.note: Exact slot counts change with progression — read the live UI, not a remembered number.

doSteps: Open Expeditions and note how many slots you have.
Fill one slot with a short dispatch.
Try recall once on a later run so you see a pro-rated report — then decide whether early return was worth it.
doNote: Stop when slot ≠ infinite and recall ≠ full payout. Core loop: [expeditions](expeditions).

mixUps.q: Can I run unlimited expeditions at once?
mixUps.a: No. Slots gate parallelism. You grow into more over time.

mixUps.q: Does recall give the full reward?
mixUps.a: No. You get what completed ticks earned — leave early, take less.
No. Collect when ready; nothing times out from neglect.

mixUps.q: Can I put the same demon on two slots?
mixUps.a: No. Demons on a live task are not free to dispatch again.
